## Shiny

```{r}
#install.packages("shiny")


library(shiny)
library(bslib)
```

```{r}

# Define UI for app
ui <- page_sidebar(
  title = "Rise in Authoritarian Values in Canada and Nato Countries",
  sidebar = sidebar("sidebar"),
  "main contents"
)


server <- function(input, output){
  renderText <- paste("the number you selected is:", input$value)
  
}

# Run the app ----
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)


```
